changes.current_line: Billing that helps you grow revenue.
changes.change: For product and engineering leads replacing a homegrown billing system: Stop pricing changes from being a tax on the roadmap. Change a price in a few clicks, not a quarter of engineering time.
changes.why: The buyer rejected the revenue-growth framing outright and described billing as a drain on the roadmap, and their engineers responded to that concrete cost.

changes.current_line: Proven ROI, backed by an independent economic impact study.
changes.change: For finance buyers: We build a payback case from your own cost of the current billing system (engineering hours, billing errors, lapsed subscriptions), ready to take to your CFO.
changes.why: The champion said he could not get the project past the CFO without a customer-specific number, and the team never built one, so the generic study did not carry the deal.

changes.change: Staged migration timed to your renewal season, so existing landlord cards are not re-collected, plus a reference customer who has done the same migration.
changes.why: The buyer ruled out touching billing outside renewal season and asked for a migration reference, and our generic timing doc did not answer either request.
